meta.name: Snap Cursor
meta.notes: Primary fills a full-height right-third plane in header, hero and catalog head and a two-thirds footer block (on-primary text there); on the slate ink it appears only as buttons, the spring cursor and a text-mixed tint so navy or near-black brands stay legible.

issues: Story image renders as an empty purple box (loading=lazy never fires in the render), and on mobile the 5th product frame is also empty
Headings use hyphens:auto, producing ugly breaks such as 'Heerlijk sla-pen' in the collection intro and catalog title
Hero has a large dead zone between the headline and the lede; the lede is small and low-contrast and the foot row has no structure
The brand plane only appears in hero and footer; the story section is a plain dark box, so the 'two planes' idea fades mid-page
Demo badge on the catalog sits on top of the sticky sort column and hides the 'Sorteer' label
Excessive bottom padding after the offset product list leaves a hollow band before the USPs
fixed: Home product and story images load eagerly (decoding=async), so frames are never empty in renders or on fast scroll
Replaced hyphens:auto with text-wrap:balance on .h2 and the catalog title: clean, balanced serif line breaks
Hero foot gets a hairline rule with a brand-tinted lead segment and a larger, higher-contrast lede, so the gap reads as composed space
Story image now sits on an offset --c-primary block (clamped to the viewport on mobile), bringing the brand plane back mid-page
Catalog badge moved to bottom-right so the left sticky category/sort column is fully readable
Tightened collection bottom padding for better vertical rhythm
